content.user_title: Design a Data Asset Trust Structure
content.value_statement: Data asset trust projects require clear rights, governance, term alignment, and regulated counterparties. This skill creates structured assessments and plans with explicit review boundaries.
actual_capabilities: Assesses whether documented data asset rights are suitable for a trust.
Compares self-benefit, third-party-benefit, and property-right trust structures.
Defines the nine core trust elements and identifies missing inputs.
Aligns trust terms with data rights registration periods and exit options.
Creates checklists for trustee, legal, tax, security, and financing reviews.
Outlines public data trust roles, authorization boundaries, and governance responsibilities.
limitations: It does not provide binding legal, tax, regulatory, or trustee opinions.
It cannot verify ownership records, licenses, registrations, or current local rules.
It cannot contact trust companies, regulators, investors, or service providers.
Its conclusions depend on complete and accurate project information.

use_cases.title: Assess Trust Feasibility
use_cases.description: Identify missing rights evidence, compliance gates, suitable trust purposes, and required professional reviews.

use_cases.title: Structure Public Data Operations
use_cases.description: Map government, trustee, operator, and beneficiary roles with clear authorization and governance boundaries.

use_cases.title: Prepare an ABS Structure
use_cases.description: Outline a property-right trust vehicle, required asset evidence, term alignment, and downstream review tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain data asset trusts, their main structures, and why the trust property should be defined as rights rather than raw data.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Feasibility Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this data asset for trust suitability: [asset], [rights evidence], [purpose], [registration term], [data categories], and [current restrictions].

prompt_templates.title: Draft the Nine Elements
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the nine trust elements for [project], list assumptions, identify missing evidence, and assign legal, tax, trustee, and security reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Stress-Test an Advanced Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed trust and ABS structure for ownership, transfer, bankruptcy remoteness, registration, tax, governance, security, and exit risks: [details].

output_examples.input: Assess a customer analytics dataset for a five-year self-benefit trust.
output_examples.output: Provisional result: remediation required. Confirm transferable operating or revenue rights, privacy compliance, registration duration, trustee acceptance, tax treatment, and renewal terms.

output_examples.input: Outline a public data trust for a municipal transport program.
output: Proposed roles: the authorized authority acts as settlor, a licensed trust company serves as trustee, and a specialist operates approved products.
Key controls: define authorization scope, permitted uses, security duties, revenue allocation, audit rights, renewal, and termination.
Required reviews: public data authority, legal counsel, trustee, privacy and security specialists, and tax advisers.

output_examples.input: Compare trust modes for employee incentives and a future securitization.
output_examples.output: Use a third-party-benefit structure for defined employee beneficiaries. Evaluate a separate property-right trust for securitization after rights, cash flows, and eligibility are verified.

best_practices: Provide rights evidence, data categories, project purpose, registration status, and intended beneficiaries.
Treat legal, tax, security, trustee, and regulatory reviews as mandatory decision gates.
Separate verified facts, assumptions, unresolved questions, and professional recommendations in every deliverable.
anti_patterns: Do not treat raw data possession as proof of transferable trust property.
Do not promise financing, bankruptcy protection, tax outcomes, or regulatory approval.
Do not set a trust term without checking registration validity, renewal, and exit requirements.

faq.question: Can this skill determine whether a trust is legally valid?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured assessment that must be reviewed by qualified counsel and a licensed trust company.

faq.question: Does it place raw data into a trust?
faq.answer: It focuses on identifiable and transferable data-related rights, because raw data may not be suitable trust property.

faq.question: Can it guarantee bankruptcy remoteness?
faq.answer: No. That outcome depends on valid transfer, trust formation, documentation, applicable law, and transaction facts.

faq.question: Does it calculate final tax liabilities?
faq.answer: No. It identifies taxable events and analysis inputs, then directs final conclusions to qualified tax advisers.

faq.question: Can it recommend a specific trust company?
faq.answer: It can define selection criteria and due diligence questions, but it cannot verify or endorse a provider.

faq.question: What information improves the assessment?
faq.answer: Provide rights records, data categories, consent basis, registration terms, revenue model, parties, purpose, restrictions, and desired exit arrangements.
